title: fragcap
descriptor: Passive process-attributed network capture for games.
functional_descriptor: Game network capture and analysis tooling
category: Game network capture and analysis tooling
role: Passive capture and decode. fragcap reads; it does not write.
audience: Curious players first, then modders, server operators, developers, protocol researchers, security engineers, and tool authors.
governing_principle: See what your game is actually saying.
assumptions: Signal Cyan is the identity accent. Capture Orange is inherited emphasis and must stay scarce.
The existing mark and custom outlined wordmark are authoritative and must not be redrawn.
The product rejects the parent brand's verbal flourish because its technical boundaries should remain literal.

chart_palette.rationale: Signal Cyan starts an evenly rotated series. The derived colors remain separated from Capture Orange and Fault while keeping equal visual priority on Void.

logo.construction: The imported 512-unit mark combines four separated capture-frame corners, a triple-bladed F, and three isolated orange packet terminals. The reduced master drops the capture frame and enlarges the F and terminals for favicon use.
prohibitions: Do not rotate, skew, stretch, outline, bevel, or add glow.
Do not recolor individual packet lanes.
Do not move the orange terminals or make them appear explosive.
Do not close the four reticle corners into a box or circle.
Do not set the wordmark in live text or a substitute typeface.
Do not place the logo over busy imagery.
Do not combine the fragcap and ShruggieTech marks into one lockup.
Do not add skulls, weapons, controllers, shields, or exploit imagery.
logo.geometry_provenance_reason: The shipped Fragcap mark and reduced master predate glyphkit. Their exact filled path data is preserved unchanged.

guide.descriptor: Passive process-attributed network capture for games.
personality: Uses exact nouns, units, formats, and commands
Names observation, capture, decode, and traces
Uses calm statements and sparse wit
Names limitations, prerequisites, and sharp edges
promises: Every row is a packet that actually happened.
Technical boundaries are stated before convenience claims.
Terminology remains consistent across CLI, docs, schemas, and interfaces.
guide.sharp_edge: Protocol knowledge can be used to write cheats. fragcap answers that risk with a strict product scope: capture and decode only, with no injection, modification, automation, or concealment.
guide.logo: The triple-bladed F represents parallel packet lanes. Four separated corners form a capture frame without a weapon-like crosshair. Orange terminals identify the isolated bytes, and the shorter lower lane keeps the silhouette legible as an F.
guide.palette: Signal Cyan marks observed data, links, focus, and active capture. Capture Orange identifies isolated terminals and warnings, and remains scarce. Fault is reserved for failed capture or hard errors. Near-black surfaces keep packet data primary.
guide.specimen_line: See what your game is actually saying.
guide.specimen_body: Every captured row is a packet that crossed the wire, timestamped and attributed to a process.
